decisions.reason: As a close design-led extension of the firm's core drainage range, this product fits existing know-how and can be supported by the firm's in-house R&D, though as a finish variant it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if demand is niche.

This shower channel is very close to the firm's established drainage competence, has clear application value for modern bathroom design, and the firm's strong related knowledge and own R&D make continued improvement and support likely.

Although the pump-assisted solution is somewhat more technically demanding than standard gravity drainage, it still builds on the firm's core offer and the firm's absorptive capacity from long experience and own R&D lowers the chance of withdrawal.

A tileable floor drain with grating is tightly aligned with the firm's existing drainage systems, customer base, and barrier-free bathroom focus, so management would be inclined to keep it on the market.

This stainless steel design grate is a close and easily assimilated addition to the established product family, and in a growing industry the firm is likely to retain such complementary design-oriented variants.
